# TidyByte — Full Site Content

Download on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/tidybyte/id6775769763

## Homepage

TidyByte — Swipe to clean your photos.

Free up storage in minutes. Swipe to delete junk photos, find duplicates and blurry shots, and compress videos — all 100% on your device. No ads, no account.

### Trust Signals

- 100% on-device processing
- No ads
- No account required
- Free forever

### How It Works

TidyByte turns photo cleanup into something you'll actually finish. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep — and reclaim gigabytes in minutes.

1. Swipe left to delete. A subtle haptic tap confirms the throw. Undo is always one tap away.
2. A deck of photos. Every review feels like flipping through a familiar stack.
3. Swipe right to keep. Saved photos flow straight to an album you pick, ready to revisit.

### Cleanup Toolkit

Beyond swiping, TidyByte packs a full toolkit of smart cleanup tools — all on-device:

- **Duplicates**: Find exact copies, byte-for-byte. Exact duplicates are matched by SHA-256 hash of the file data.
- **Similar photos**: Group near-identical shots. Near-duplicates use Apple Vision feature prints to find visually similar shots.
- **Screenshots**: Round up and clear in one tap.
- **Blurry photos**: Spot out-of-focus and shaky shots.
- **Large files**: Surface the biggest space hogs.
- **Burst photos**: Pick the best from a sequence.
- **Live Photos**: Convert to stills to save space.
- **Video compression**: Shrink videos, keep them watchable.
- **Photo compression**: Re-encode photos to reclaim space.
- **Smart Categories**: Sort by content type, browse faster.

### Privacy Promise

Your photos never leave your phone.

- All processing happens on-device using Apple's Photos and Vision frameworks.
- No backend, no analytics, no third-party scripts, no tracking — anywhere.
- We can't see your photos. We don't want to.

### Storage Dashboard

A live donut chart of where your storage goes — photos, videos, screenshots, Live Photos, other. Tappable slices drill into the exact items you can free up.

### Open Source

TidyByte is MIT-licensed. Read the source, verify the claims, file an issue. GitHub: https://github.com/360ghar/snap-clean-ios

### Frequently Asked Questions

**Does TidyByte upload my photos?**
No. All processing happens locally on your iPhone using Apple's Photos and Vision frameworks. TidyByte has no backend, no analytics, and no network calls of any kind.

**What about iCloud-only photos?**
TidyByte works with your full library, including assets stored only in iCloud. The system downloads them as needed; you can also swipe past without waiting.

**Are deleted photos gone immediately?**
They go to the iOS Recently Deleted album, where they sit for 30 days before being permanently removed — exactly like deleting from the Photos app.

**Will it lower the quality of my photos?**
No cleanup tool touches the originals. The only operation that re-encodes is the explicit Video Compression or Photo Compression tool, and you choose the preset.

**How are duplicates detected?**
Exact duplicates are matched by SHA-256 hash of the file data. Near-duplicates use Apple Vision feature prints to find visually similar shots.

**Is there a free trial or subscription?**
TidyByte is free, with no in-app purchases and no paywalls. Every feature is available to every user.

**Does TidyByte support iPad?**
Yes. TidyByte is a universal app that runs natively on iPhone and iPad. Every cleanup tool works on both, the swipe interface adapts to the iPad's larger screen, and iPad supports all orientations.

**How do I report a bug or request a feature?**
Open an issue on GitHub (https://github.com/360ghar/snap-clean-ios) or use the contact form on the Support page.

---

## Privacy Policy

Effective: January 1, 2026.

TidyByte is 100% on-device. We collect no data from you. No photos, no usage analytics, no personal information, no crash reports with PII. The app has no backend server, no analytics SDK, and no third-party dependencies that could transmit data. All photo analysis and processing uses Apple's built-in Photos and Vision frameworks on your device.

Permissions requested: Photo Library (read & write) — required for the app to function. Notifications — optional, only for cleanup reminders.

Data storage: TidyByte stores local records (SwipeRecord, CompressionRecord, StorageSnapshot) using SwiftData in a sandboxed database on your phone. This data never leaves your device and can be cleared via Settings → Reset Swipe History.

Read the full privacy policy at https://tidybyte.360ghar.com/privacy.

## Changelog

### v1.0.2 — Storage Dashboard Redesign (July 2026)

Redesigned the Storage dashboard with a reclaim hero, added cross-tab deep-linking from storage insights into swipe sessions and cleanup tools, fixed issues across the cleanup tools, and added a storage-dashboard test suite.

### v1.0.1 — iPad Support (June 2026)

Added native iPad support (TidyByte is now a universal app), fixed the album picker dismiss behavior when starting a swipe session, and improved the Settings layout on larger screens.

### v1.0 — Initial Release (January 2026)

TidyByte 1.0 is the first public build. Features include swipe-to-review photo cleanup, duplicate detection (SHA-256 and Vision feature prints), similar photo grouping, screenshot cleanup, blurry photo detection, large file finder, burst photo management, Live Photo conversion, video compression, photo compression, smart categories, and a storage dashboard.
